revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Ἀμο\ῦν/ is clearly legible in l6, there is no ink before the name. What looks like ink is a tear. l8: τοῦ ὄν̣[τ]ο̣ς̣ is convincing as well, the letter after τοῦ is clearly an ο and several parallels suggest the proposed reading. l9: The upper part of the koppa is clearly legible and an epsilon is not impossible. Furthermore, 95/64 are the years of the Oxyrhynchite era to be expected here.

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Line break clearly correct. Lin6 I can see Ἀμο\ῦν/ in the digital image (http://www.psi-online.it/documents/psi;13;1365); at first I thought I saw ink between the omega of υἱῷ and alpha of Ἀμο\ῦν/, but I now think this is a tear. Lin8: ἀπὸ τοῦ [ὄ]ν̣τ̣ο̣ς μηνὸς is good (many parallels); lin9 I am not sure I can see the numbers. Next voter? Note, both PN D. Hagedorn should be PN D. Hagedorn (digital image)

Korrektur des falschen Zeilenbruchs in der Edition: Ab Αὐγούστων wird Z. 2 = Z. 3, danach muß daher ab Z. 3 alles um 1 erhöht werden (so an der Abbildung). Z. 4 (neu): Εὐδαίμονος → Εὐδαίμονος (l. Εὐδαίμων). Z. 6 (neu): |Ὥ̣ρ̣ο̣υ̣ → Ἀμο\ῦν/̣ (an der Abbildung). Z. 8 (neu): τούτου [το]ῦ → τοῦ ὄν̣[τ]ο̣ς̣ (an der Abbildung). Z. 9 (neu): ἔτους ̣̅[ → ἔτους ϙ̣̅ε̣̅ [ξ̅δ̅ (an der Abbildung).
